chain: Wiring and EV parts cost more
NEWS.why: Copper is a core input in vehicle wiring and motors. Carmakers can pass costs on only slowly, so the squeeze builds over a month, then fades as prices adjust.

NEWS.t: RBI holds rates, signals easing later
NEWS.why: Banks gain from higher loan growth once rates fall. Auto buyers also finance vehicles, so cheaper credit helps demand a little.

NEWS.t: Crude oil jumps 4% in a week
NEWS.why: Many paint raw materials are crude derivatives, so costs rise within weeks. Vehicle makers feel a small effect through fuel-price-sensitive demand. Reliance benefits as a producer and refiner.

NEWS.t: Rupee slips to a fresh low against the dollar
NEWS.why: IT exporters bill in dollars, so a weaker rupee lifts reported earnings. Carmakers with imported parts see a small cost increase.

NEWS.t: US firms signal slower tech spending
NEWS.why: A large share of Indian IT revenue comes from US clients. Slower budgets show up in deal wins first, then in revenue over several quarters.
